subject: Re: Aligning demo for CTO late add — options & fallbacks
messages:

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — CTO wants to join

Hi David (and Tom),

Quick heads up: our CTO has asked to join the demo this afternoon but is flying in and may not be on-site until ~12:30 PT. If possible, can we either move the start 30 minutes later or split the session so the CTO can join the exec portion when they land? We prefer not to push things to another day if we can avoid it — there are a couple of cross-team folks traveling who won't be available later in the week.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

Ellen

Helios Analytics

Subject: Re: Quick ask — CTO wants to join

Team — Ellen flagged that the Helios CTO may be a ~12:30 PT arrival and would like to join the demo. Options I'd like to propose quickly so we can offer a couple of clear paths: 

1) Shift the full demo start 30m later (start 12:30 PT) — keeps single session, risks conflicting with other attendee schedules.
2) Keep original start time, run the core product walkthrough, then schedule a 20–30m "exec intro" block when CTO arrives (same day). We'll need a condensed exec slide set.
3) Keep time but have Kimberly or me run the first 15 minutes of the exec intro; CTO does a short live Q&A when they land (backup: recorded 3–4 minute CTO message).

Rafael — can you produce a 15–20m tech deep-dive condensed deck we can slot if we compress? Priyom — please prepare a trimmed agenda and a one-page exec talking points doc. Kimberly — can you lead the exec intro if we need to run before CTO lands?

I'll respond to Ellen with these three options and recommend we keep the day but split (option 2) unless they prefer shifting the entire slot.

-David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@heliosanalytics.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@heliosanalytics.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning demo for CTO late add — options & fallbacks

Hi Ellen — thanks for the heads up. We can absolutely accommodate; below are concise tradeoffs so you can pick what works best for the team: 

Option A — Shift entire session +45m (start 12:45 PT)
- Pros: single uninterrupted demo, full Q&A with both product and infra.
- Cons: May conflict with other Helios attendees' travel windows.

Option B — Split session (recommended)
- 12:00–12:30 PT: Product + infra walkthrough (standard audience)
- 12:45–13:05 PT: Exec intro / CTO Q&A (CTO joins for this block)
- Pros: Minimizes disruption to attendees who need to depart early; CTO still participates in the exec portion.

Option C — Keep time, we run exec intro + record 3–4m CTO note for the Q&A
- Pros: No reschedule; fastest for attendees.
- Cons: Less live CTO interaction.

Attachments: I’m attaching a tight 2-slide exec talking points doc and a trimmed agenda (Demo_Agenda_v3.docx). Rafael has a 15–20m condensed tech deck ready if we need to compress.

If you can confirm which option you prefer I’ll lock the calendar and send updated invites (and a short agenda PDF for the exec block).

Thanks — Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions Consulting, Redwood Inference

From: Ellen Park <ellen@heliosanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>

Kimberly / David — thanks, and really helpful choices. Given the CTO's arrival window and other team members' schedules, Option B (split) is best for us: run the product walkthrough at the original time and then hold a 25-minute exec intro / live Q&A beginning at 12:45 PT.

Two small asks: 
- Can you record the exec block and send the clip (we have a remote executive who must review asynchronously)?
- Please include any high-level security/compliance notes in the exec packet (we'll share with our CISO).

Confirming: product walkthrough starts at 12:00 PT (no change); exec intro 12:45–13:10 PT. Please send updated invites and the short agenda.

Appreciate the flexibility — Ellen
